scripts.lint:design: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path");let errs=[];const walk=(d,fn)=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);e.isDirectory()?walk(p,fn):fn(p)}};for(const dir of ["app","components"])walk(dir,p=>{if(!/\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(p))return;const c=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8");if(/from\s+["\x27]cn["\x27]/.test(c))errs.push(p+": import cn from @/lib/utils instead of \"cn\"")});walk("components/ui",p=>{if(!p.endsWith(".tsx"))return;const c=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8");if(/animate-in/.test(c)&&/motion-reduce:animate-none/.test(c))errs.push(p+": keep opacity fade under motion-reduce instead of motion-reduce:animate-none");if(/animate-in/.test(c)&&/animate-out/.test(c)&&!/data-\[state=closed\]:duration-/.test(c))errs.push(p+": triggered overlays must specify asymmetric open/closed durations (e.g. data-[state=open]:duration-250 data-[state=closed]:duration-180)")});walk("content/docs/components",p=>{if(!p.endsWith(".mdx"))return;const c=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8");if(!/<ComponentInstallation\b/.test(c))errs.push(p+": missing <ComponentInstallation />");if(/@rakfound\//.test(c))errs.push(p+": contains stale @rakfound/ reference")});if(errs.length){console.error(errs.join("\n"));process.exit(1)}console.log("✓ Design system checks passed")'
